channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Surat Businessman Honours Mother’s Memory by Paying Off ₹89.89 Lakh Debts, Freeing 290+ Farmers After 30 Years of Struggle
item.description: On his mother’s death anniversary, a Surat industrialist clears three decades-old debts, helping 290 Gujarat farmers reclaim their land and livelihoods.

item.title: Arunachal Youth Group Questions Mosque Legality; Asks Muslim Cleric to Chant ‘Bharat Mata Ki Jai’ in Video
item.description: A viral video from Itanagar shows the APIYO questioning a mosque’s legality has gone viral with mixed reactions from people online.

item.title: Putin Praises PM Modi’s ‘Wise Leadership’ Amid US Tariff Pressure on Russian Oil
item.description: Russian President Putin commended PM Modi's resistance to US tariffs during his December 2025 India visit, advancing defence and $65 billion trade ties.

item.title: Meta Removes 500,000 Teen Accounts Ahead of Australia’s Under-16 Nationwide Social Media Ban
item.description: Meta deactivates around 500,000 under-16 accounts across its platforms in Australia.

item.title: Karnataka: Police and Bank Manager Stop ‘Digital Arrest’ Scam, Prevent Elderly Couple From Losing Rs 84 Lakh
item.description: Vigilant bank manager and Mulki police intervened to prevent Rs 84 lakh loss for an 84-year-old couple targeted by scammers.

item.title: Bengaluru Techie, 45, Dies by Suicide in Whitefield Dream Home After Neighbours’ Rs 20 Lakh Harassment, BBMP Notices
item.description: A 45-year-old father's tragic suicide in his under-construction Nallurhalli home followed relentless extortion demands and civic harassment by neighbours, leaving a 10-page note and sparking arrests.

item.title: 710 JKLI Agniveers Complete Training, Oath to Protect J&K Civilians in Srinagar Parade Amid Security Drills
item.description: Chief Minister Omar Abdullah hails 710 local JKLI Agniveers as nation's shields after their Srinagar passing out parade, emphasising safety training against regional threats.

item.title: RBI Cuts Repo Rate by 25 Basis Points to 5.25%, Loan EMIs to Fall, GDP Growth Outlook Raised to 7.3%: All You Need to Know
item.description: Reserve Bank of India reduces repo rate to 5.25 per cent in sixth consecutive cut, projecting 7.3 per cent FY26 GDP growth.

item.title: ‘We couldn’t live up to our promise’: IndiGo CEO Issues Apology to Staff After Over 1,200+ Flight Cancellations
item.description: IndiGo's CEO apologised for over 1,200 flight cancellations triggered by new crew rules, stranding lakhs as the airline plans cuts and seeks exemptions till February 2026.​

item.title: IIT Kharagpur Study: Paper Cups Release 25,000 Microplastics into Hot Tea in 15 Minutes, Risking Cancer Daily
item.description: IIT Kharagpur's research uncovers how disposable paper cups leach 25,000 microplastic particles into hot beverages in 15 minutes, urging a switch to kulhads or steel for health and eco-safety.
